legend.accounts: domestic household accounts of the band, the accounts carved from one counted under its parent's band
legend.average_hourly_pay: the wage bill over the employed persons and the hours a person (hours_per_person), rounded down
legend.employed_persons: persons at work at the opening, over the members of the accounts
legend.key: the household account's budget key: earning-lower-paid-half, earning-better-paid-forty, earning-owner, no-earner-nonowner, no-earner-owner, collective-residence
legend.looking_persons: persons looking for work at the opening
legend.persons: persons of those accounts, at work, looking or neither
legend.place: the hub county's geoid of a pooled place; the nation is the sum of the places
legend.wage_bill_micros: one period's wages in millionths of a dollar: the wage times the member's employed persons times the member's hours a person, over the members paid a wage
